"description": "### Impact

When `multer` is configured with an asynchronous `fileFilter`, the `limits.fileSize` limit can be bypassed. The `'limit'` event is registered inside the async `fileFilter` callback, so if a file exceeds `limits.fileSize` before that callback runs, the event is missed and the oversized upload is accepted instead of being rejected with a `LIMIT_FILE_SIZE` error. Applications that rely on `limits.fileSize` to reject oversized uploads are affected on all upload methods (`.single()`, `.array()`, `.fields()`, `.any()`). Uploads using a synchronous `fileFilter` are not affected.

### Patches

Users should upgrade to `2.3.0`.

### Workarounds

Use a synchronous `fileFilter`, or validate the uploaded file size after the upload completes.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.0016, "percentile": 0.05464}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-qvfw-j98x-7q72", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-08T21:29:42Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qvfw-j98x-7q72", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-qvfw-j98x-7q72"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-77063"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-08-28T22:16:53Z", "published_at": "2026-09-08T21:29:42Z", "references": ["https://github.com/expressjs/multer/security/advisories/GHSA-qvfw-j98x-7q72", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-77063", "https://github.com/expressjs/multer/commit/ab6aeae650328cf31799dcfa4c3e116ba8faaacc", "https://cna.openjsf.org/security-advisories.html", "https://github.com/expressjs/multer/releases/tag/v2.3.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qvfw-j98x-7q72"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/expressjs/multer/security-advisories/GHSA-qvfw-j98x-7q72", "severity": "low", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/expressjs/multer", "summary": "multer vulnerable to file size limit bypass via async fileFilter race condition", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-08T21:29:43Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-qvfw-j98x-7q72", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "2.3.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "multer"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 2.3.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
